name: Roasted Chestnut
description: Try to crack a chestnut with brute force, and you will only hurt yourself. Dip one in oil, another in water, place them in a pot, cover with the rest of the chestnuts, and roast them over a fire. You will know when they are ready when you hear a thundering CRACK.
